name: uiSurfaces
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup / reusable asset sheet. Create ONE coherent 3 columns by 3 rows transparent sprite sheet, ideally 1536x1536. Each cell is equally sized, each object fully contained and centered in its cell. Style: match the Corovaner reference: coffee-cream enamel painted metal, tarnished brass rolled rims, blued-steel housings, restrained rust and patina, high-quality realistic game UI texture. Orthographic straight front view, no perspective. Fully transparent RGBA background. Every object disconnected with generous transparent gutters. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, captions, symbols, logos or watermarks. No baked checkerboard. No backdrop. These are production sprites, not a screenshot or concept presentation. Exact reading order: Row 1: (1) long blank coffee-cream enamel capsule button in normal state, (2) same identical silhouette blank button in hover state with subtle lighter brass rim, no glow and no lamp, (3) same identical silhouette blank button depressed/pressed with slightly darkened face and inset shadow. These three buttons must have the same dimensions and rounded ends. Row 2: (1) blank dark steel rectangular utility button with softly rounded corners, (2) blank cream enamel selected tab plate with four corner screws, (3) dark recessed empty inventory slot, square, subtle brass rim. Row 3: (1) dark rusted-steel rounded rectangular panel with dark solid flat center, (2) matching heavy rusted steel frame with COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT empty center opening, (3) rounded rectangular cream enamel panel with solid cream center and dark steel metal rim. The three lower panels are square-ish, same overall footprint, four corner fasteners, NO fasteners along the middle of edges. Lower-panel border decorations must be limited to corners so the edge midsections and center are suitable for nine-slice scaling. Button row has each object about 420 pixels wide and 140 pixels high inside 512x512 cells, second row control shapes about 360 wide x170 high except square slot 280x280, bottom row panels about400x360. Keep exact3x3 order, generous empty space between every object. Do not include lights, icons, dials or labels on any surface. All pixels outside sprite shapes transparent, translucent shadows tightly confined.

name: uiHardware
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup / reusable asset sheet. Create ONE transparent sprite sheet in exactly 4 columns x 3 rows of evenly spaced isolated components, ideally1536x1152. Each object centered within its own equal-sized cell, no overlap. Style: match the Corovaner reference: coffee-cream enamel painted metal, tarnished brass rolled rims, blued-steel housings, restrained rust and patina, high-quality realistic game UI texture. Orthographic straight front view, no perspective. Fully transparent RGBA background. Every object disconnected with generous transparent gutters. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, captions, symbols, logos or watermarks. No baked checkerboard. No backdrop. These are production sprites, not a screenshot or concept presentation. Exact reading order row1: (1) circular amber glass pilot lamp OFF in round brass bezel, dark amber glass, (2) IDENTICAL circular pilot lamp ON with warm amber glass and tight warm halo, same outer diameter, (3) round brass rotary volume knob with small pointer mark at twelve o'clock, no dial numbers, (4) semicircular condition-gauge FACE with cream backing, red/ochre/olive arc bands and tick marks, NO needle and no text. Row2: (1) standalone slender red-brass instrument NEEDLE pointing straight upward, small round pivot at its bottom, (2) vertical steel hinge with3barrel segments, (3) dark rectangular speaker grille with horizontal slots and four corner screws, (4) L-shaped dark steel corner bracket with visible bolts. Row3: (1) one round slotted dark steel screw head, (2) horizontal toggle SOCKET only, dark recessed rounded slot with cream enamel bezel, NO toggle handle, (3) separate small horizontal knurled brass toggle HANDLE to slide within the socket, (4) small vertical ribbed brass scrollbar THUMB only, no track. No attached labels or words anywhere. Lamp pair must stay perfectly circular, matched size. Dial and gauge are fixed-size components. Each object is isolated on genuine transparency for programmatic extraction. No wood, no neon, no fantasy ornaments.
